summary: A 58-year-old out-of-state skier who accidentally left the Steamboat Resort boundary became stranded in the Fish Creek drainage; first responders traced his phone to get a location pin (voice calls would not go through in the drainage, only texts). Three Routt County Search and Rescue volunteers skied down from the resort, located him just above Fish Creek near the upper falls along the creek's namesake trail, and traversed with him back to the ski area via Pioneer Ridge; he was reunited with his family around 5:30 p.m., uninjured.
location: Fish Creek drainage, outside Steamboat Resort boundary
notes: DATE PINNED: KIFT article published Friday 2019-12-27 (search-index metadata: 2452 days before 2026-09-13); incident 'Thursday' = 2019-12-26 (Thursday verified, America/Denver). RCSAR's first call for service at the ski area that winter; incident commander Kristia Check-Hill; victim was skiing alone. Story references the Jan-2019 Holy Bowl skier (id 2506) as a prior incident.
